critique.evidence: The screen directly supports the defense story with a payment kill-chain taxonomy that includes intent, tool, merchant, and payment manipulation; separates AGENTIC from CLASSIC vectors; exposes only safe metadata and observable signals; and routes a selected vector to a scored replay. However, every supplied viewport visibly defaults to CLASSIC and showcases credential-stuffed card-not-present fraud, so the claimed new agentic intent-integrity terrain is not actually demonstrated. No visible Mastercard-specific use case, network value, or agentic-commerce outcome connects the atlas to the hackathon brief.
critique.fix: Make AGENTIC the demo default and select a flagship payment-intent attack that visibly traces corrupted user intent through tool/merchant/payment stages. Show its observable evidence, defense decision, and protected payment outcome, then explicitly tie that outcome to Mastercard-relevant network trust, merchant acceptance, cardholder safety, or fraud-loss reduction.
